body:
**Blocked by #167. Should land before #178.**

Maintenance and Data & Retention are genuine configuration and stay in Settings — but they live at `/settings/system/maintenance` and `/settings/system/data`, which would sit beside a new top-level `/system` section meaning something entirely different. A search for `/settings/system` would hit pages in both.

### Change

- `/settings/system/maintenance` becomes `/settings/maintenance`
- `/settings/system/data` becomes `/settings/data-retention`
- Retire the `/settings/system` overview entirely; it is superseded by the new `/system` dashboard.
- Redirects and ROUTE_PERMISSIONS entries for old and new, per the rule in #167.

**Keep the existing permissions unchanged** (`SYSTEM_MANAGE_MAINTENANCE`, `SYSTEM_MANAGE_DATA_RETENTION`). This is a path move, not an authorization change; do not alter semantics in the same slice.

The Settings group holding these is named "Maintenance & Data", not "System", for the same reason.

### Verify

`npm test`; confirm "Prune Data" still works beside the retention setting — the trigger stays with its rule, per ADR-0004.

title: Settings IA slice 9: rename /settings/system/* so one word means one thing
